Consultation

We listen first. Understanding your pain history and goals before any hands-on work begins.

Assessment

A hands-on posture and mobility exam pinpoints what’s actually driving the problem, not just the symptom.

Treatment

A plan built around you — adjustments, DECOM, needling, or ultrasound, combined as needed.

Recovery & Review

We track how you’re progressing and adjust the plan, through full recovery and beyond.

Care built around how your body moves

Four treatments, one philosophy — see what each one actually looks like before you book.

Demo animation · video coming soon

Chiropractic Treatment

Precise spinal and joint adjustments to restore alignment and mobility.

  • Hands-on assessment before any adjustment is made
  • Targeted joint mobilisation, not a generic routine
  • Most patients feel looser within the first few sessions
Demo animation · video coming soon

DECOM Therapy

Decompression therapy that eases pressure on the spine and discs.

  • Gentle traction, fully controlled and adjustable
  • Aimed at disc-related and nerve-related pain
  • Comfortable — most patients relax or doze off
Actual treatment footage

Fascia Needling

Targeted needling to release tight fascia and muscle tension.

  • Fine, sterile needles at specific tension points
  • A brief sensation, not a lingering pain
  • Often paired with stretching for faster release
Actual treatment footage

Ultrasound Therapy

Deep-tissue ultrasound to reduce inflammation and support healing.

  • A handheld probe delivers deep, gentle heat
  • Painless — most patients only feel light warmth
  • Speeds up recovery for soft-tissue injuries

OUR TEAM

Meet your chiropractors

Select a chiropractor below to learn more about them.

Jason Wong, D.C.

BSc (Hons) Chiropractic Certified Sports Injury Practitioner

Jason is a dedicated chiropractor focused on helping patients move better, live pain-free, and regain confidence in their bodies. His evidence-based, non-invasive approach was refined through hands-on clinical experience in Johor Bahru, treating everything from chronic desk-job pain to sports injuries.

Max Lim, D.C.

Chiropractic Specialist Practising Since 2015

Max is a chiropractor with a decade of clinical experience, having cared for patients with neck, back, knee, and joint concerns across Penang. His approach blends evidence-based chiropractic care with insights drawn from traditional bone-setting, aiming to restore movement and support long-term wellbeing rather than simply ease pain.
